data.name: Shell Heroes: Awesome Island
data.detailed_description:
Change your shell. Awaken new abilities. Save Awesome Island!

Shell Heroes: Awesome Island is a colorful 2D side-scrolling action-adventure platformer where you explore a vibrant island alongside a cast of unique hermit crab heroes.

After a violent storm, the fragments that once protected Awesome Island are scattered across the land. Join forces with heroes who wield different abilities, explore beaches, jungles, rocky shores, tidal pools, a shipwreck, and ancient deep-sea ruins, and recover the lost fragments.

A New Adventure with Every Shell

Equip the shells you collect to change not only your appearance, but also the special abilities available to you. Choose the right shell and hero for each situation, overcome obstacles, uncover hidden paths, and take on powerful enemies and bosses.

Unique Hermit Crab Heroes

Each hero has their own attacks, movement abilities, and ultimate skill. Complete character story quests to discover their struggles and growth, while unlocking new abilities and rewards.

Explore Awesome Island

From sparkling beaches to mysterious deep-sea ruins, every region features its own environment, mechanics, and challenges. Find hidden collectibles and shells, help the island's residents, and uncover the secrets buried across Awesome Island.

Key Features

- Charming hand-painted 2D pixel art

- Exploration, combat, and platforming combined in one adventure

- A variety of shells that change both appearance and abilities

- Distinct hermit crab heroes with character-focused story quests

- Unique regional mechanics and boss battles

- Collectibles, minigames, and hidden areas

- Keyboard and game controller support
